description: Implement a real 3-state (closed/open/half-open) circuit breaker in place of a stub that always calls through
prompts: src/lib.rs's CircuitBreaker::call always just calls fn(). Implement the real 3-state machine: CircuitBreaker::new(failure_threshold: u32, reset_timeout: i64). Starts Closed. In Closed, call invokes fn(); if it returns Err, count consecutive failures, and once `failure_threshold` CONSECUTIVE failures have happened, trip to Open (recording when it opened) and return that Err. While Open, call must NOT invoke fn() at all and must instead return Err(CircuitError::Open) - UNLESS at least `reset_timeout` seconds have passed since it opened, in which case it moves to HalfOpen and allows exactly ONE trial call: if that call succeeds, go back to Closed (reset the failure count); if it errors, go back to Open and RESET the open-time to `now` (so the next trial is only allowed after another full reset_timeout, not immediately).
name: add_rust_circuit_breaker_state_machine
